# Cityfans

> > Cityfans offers self-guided digital experiences, audio tours, and interactive city games across major European and global destinations including Barcelona, Berlin, Amsterdam, Lisbon, Rome, London, and Paris.

The platform specializes in immersive urban exploration through scavenger hunts, walking tours, outdoor escape games, and audio-guided experiences at landmarks. Activities range from family-friendly treasure hunts to ghost tours and culinary experiences, all designed for independent travelers seeking flexible, app-based city discovery.

## Key Topics

- Self-guided tours
- City games and escape rooms
- Audio guides
- Barcelona (Sagrada Familia, Gaudí)
- Amsterdam
- Berlin
- Lisbon
- Rome
- London
- Scavenger hunts
- Walking tours
- Outdoor activities
- Immersive experiences
- Family-friendly activities
- VoxCity partnerships

## Major European Cities

- [Cityfans | Explore Berlin with Digital Experiences](https://cityfans.com/en/city/6-berlin): Berlin city guide with self-guided tours and outdoor escape games
- [Cityfans | Explore Barcelona with Digital Experiences](https://cityfans.com/en/barcelona/prod/110-barcelona-selfguided-discovery-pack): Barcelona self-guided audio tour of Gaudí landmarks and top sites
- [Cityfans | Explore Marseille with Digital Experiences](https://cityfans.com/en/city/42-marseille-): Marseille city guide with digital games and immersive activities
- [Cityfans | Explore Strasbourg with Digital Experiences](https://cityfans.com/en/city/41-strasbourg-): Strasbourg city guide with self-guided tours and immersive experiences
- [Cityfans | Explore Lille with Digital Experiences](https://cityfans.com/en/city/51-lille-): Lille city guide with digital experiences and urban activities
- [Cityfans | Explore Ljubljana with Digital Experiences](https://cityfans.com/en/city/99-ljubljana-): Ljubljana city guide with immersive digital experiences

## Landmark Audio Tours & Entry Tickets

- [La Sagrada Familia Audio Tour: Discover at Your Pace](https://cityfans.com/en/barcelona/prod/111-la-sagrada-familia-selfguided-audio-tour): Self-guided multilingual audio tour of Gaudí's Sagrada Familia
- [Visit Castel Sant'Elmo: Naples Entry Ticket & Museum Tour](https://cityfans.com/en/naples-/prod/347-castel-sant-elmo-in-naples-entry-ticket-audio-guide): Castel Sant'Elmo entry ticket with self-guided audio tour in Naples
- [Visit Juliet's House in Verona | Skip the Line + Audio Guide](https://cityfans.com/en/verona-/prod/354-juliets-house-in-verona-fasttrack-entry-ticket-audio-guide): Juliet's House fast-track entry with audio guide in Verona

## Family-Friendly Activities & Treasure Hunts

- [Berlin Family Treasure Hunt – Alexanderplatz Adventure](https://cityfans.com/en/berlin/prod/564-treasure-hunt-berlin-alexanderplatz-great-for-kids): Family treasure hunt at Berlin Alexanderplatz for kids aged 5-9
- [Hidden Gems of Lisbon Kids-Friendly Game](https://cityfans.com/en/lisbon/prod/566-hidden-gems-of-lisbon-kidsfriendly-game): Kids-friendly scavenger hunt exploring Lisbon's hidden landmarks

## Themed Walking Tours & Experiences

- [Explore Rome's History of Power: Colosseum to Piazza Navona](https://cityfans.com/en/rome/prod/282-the-history-of-power-in-modern-rome-a-walking-tour-in-the-ancient-city): Rome walking tour from Colosseum through ancient political landmarks
- [London Ghost Tour: The Headless Horseman's Haunting in Camden](https://cityfans.com/en/london/prod/323-the-headless-horseman-in-london-a-camden-ghost-story-experience): Camden ghost tour exploring Headless Horseman legend at Primrose Hill
- [Authentic Naples Pizza Tour | Explore the Origins of Real Pizza](https://cityfans.com/en/naples-/prod/368-old-town-naples-the-story-of-real-pizza): Naples Old Town culinary tour exploring authentic Neapolitan pizza
